title: Evaluate typed backend contracts
purpose: Compile and locally evaluate explicit typed Query, Calculation, Mapping, Policy, Rule, guard, and permission contracts through one bounded SFOL kernel without implicit data access, target execution, or authority.
inputs: closed AlchLang typed-backend source selecting sfol-v1
outputs: typed SFOL term and formula projections
policies: One bounded SFOL kernel owns all declarative conditions
Predicate is a contextual SFOL formula role, not a second language
Policy selection never executes or authorizes its target
Runtime providers and ORODI evidence evaluation remain downstream and distinct
exclusions: ORODI verdict generation from source alone
claim_ceiling: Candidate product capability only; implementation tests do not accept, admit, publish, release, deploy, merge, or authorize it.
